answer: A seat is collateralized by one numbered disc of vegetable ivory cut from a tagua nut, lodged in a bonded haven: a basalt-walled vault whose warden photographs each disc's grain at intake and quarantines it for the epoch. Ten thousand cloned wallets sharing one agent still hold one disc in one slot, so the cluster collapses into a single seat. More seats mean more discs, more slots and a separate warden countersignature per intake; that warden is staked and slashed for duplicate grain records. One bonded deposit per seat against flat per-seat emission: mass registration stops paying.
